mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with corticosteroids increases risk of hypertensive crisis, CNS stimulation, and serotonergic effects; prednisone may also increase MAOI levels through CYP450 inhibition.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest prednisone dose, monitor blood pressure closely, and counsel patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms (severe headache, chest pain, vision changes).
